what: The next/ spacing repair ran its full lint while another job held the local typed-API check reservation. Its first formatter also overlapped a test that created temporary lint fixtures and failed EISDIR.
cause: The worker started whole checks despite a named heavy-check hold and initially overlapped mutation of the fixture files with formatting.
fix: The worker preserved the failed run and ran format, lint and the final whole-file test sequentially. They passed. The full lint included local typed-API checks; no external paid model call is claimed. The lead kept this overlap separate from the passing results and stopped further checks before publication.
test: A check runner could hold one local heavy-check lease and order formatting before tests that create repository fixtures.
